description: Standalone star rating of an OpenStreetMap element (node, way, or relation)

subject.description: The OpenStreetMap element (node, way, or relation) being rated

rating.description: Rating from 0 (no stars) to 120 (full rating). 120 is divisible by 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, and 10, so it adapts to those star systems without rounding.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the rating was created
